game.name: Dead by Daylight
game.rules:
Welcome to our Dead by Daylight Speedrunning Ruleset!

- PTB runs will not be accepted.
- Runs must be from patch **6.1.0 onwards**.
- Runs using **event objects or boosts** that provide an advantage **to you** will be rejected.
- Allowed game modifiers: **Chaos Shuffle**.
- Not allowed game modifiers/mode: **2v8, Lights Out, My Little Oni**

#### **Run Requirements:**

- **Start in the lobby, end at the scoreboard screen**.
- Each run can only be submitted for **one category**.
- Game must be in **full screen**.
- **Minimum 720p 30FPS**, raw footage only (no cuts or speed-ups).
- **No overlays** covering necessary verification elements.
- **In-game audio** must be included.
- Runs must be **recorded and submitted by the player themselves**.
- **Modded controllers, hacked/injected accounts will lead to rejection**.

#### **Timing & Other Rules:**

- **Start and end timing follows category rules**.
- All runs are **timed in milliseconds**.
- **Macros are not allowed** (Wiggle, Struggle, AFK, etc.)
- Bugs/glitches that **don’t give an advantage** will be accepted.
- Disconnects will be judged at the verifier’s discretion.

**Killers can't DC** (Nagisa)

(A form of timing is now mandatory for milliseconds. Implemented in 2019)

**This is a legacy board, all new runs will go to the new Escape**

categories.name: Tutorial
categories.rules:
# **Tutorial must be completed**.

#### **General Rules:**

- The game must be in **full screen**.
- **Stretched resolutions and FOV changes** are not allowed.
- **Nothing can be covered** that is required for verification.
- **The tutorial selection menu must be shown** at the start of the video.
- **In-game audio** must be included.

#### **Survivor:**

- **Timer starts** when the pop-up box **begins to fade**.
- **Escape via Hatch:** Timer **ends** when the pop-up box **appears**.
- **Escape via Door:** Timer **ends** when the **Escape icon appears**.

#### **Killer:**

- **Timer starts** when the pop-up box **begins to fade**.
- **Timer ends** when the **red hook bar from Jake disappears**.

#### **Full:**

- **Both tutorials** must be **completed in one run** without splicing.
- **Load time between tutorials is removed** for consistency.

#### **Survivor/Killer vs Bot:**

- **Both Scoreboard screens** must be shown at the end.

#### **Timing & Other Rules:**

- **RTA timing required**, pausing the timer is not allowed.
- Runs are **timed in milliseconds**.
- **Macros are not allowed** (wiggle, struggle, AFK, etc.).

**Bugs/glitches that do not give an advantage are accepted**.

categories.name: Killer
categories.rules:
# All survivors must be killed or sacrificed.

### **General Rules:**

- Recording must start in the lobby and optionally end at the scoreboard.
- If in-game names are turned off, the scoreboard must be shown at the end.
- The game must be in full screen.
- Stretched resolution or FOV changes are not allowed.
- No essential verification elements should be covered.
- In-game audio is required.
- Timing:
    - Starts when the black bars (top/bottom) disappear.
    - Ends when the last hook bar next to the player's name disappears.
    - If the last survivor is killed with Memento Mori or a similar ability (Finishing Mori, Killer Power), time ends when the "kill" bloodpoint score event appears (top right).
- RTA timing is required, pausing is not allowed.
- Runs are timed in milliseconds.
- Macros (wiggle/struggle/AFK, etc.) are not allowed.
- Bugs/glitches are allowed if they provide no advantage.

### **Solo:**

- Any Perks, Items, Add-ons and Offerings are allowed.
- The run is invalid if:
    - A player is AFK, throwing, or trying to kill themselves.
    - The killer does not interact with a survivor who then disconnects.
    - two or more disconnect
- The run remains valid if:
    - All four survivors are downed, have not been hooked, and a maximum of four disconnect (applies in similar cases).
    - If a survivor commits suicide on the hook but 3 of the 4 survivors are in the dying state, on a hook or dead
    - If two or more survivors are disconnected but have previously hooked or put in a dying state.

### **KYF (Kill Your Friends):**

- The host chooses the map.
- All survivors must be killed.
- Any Perks, Items, Add-ons, and Offerings are allowed.

categories.name: Killer vs Bot - 1 v 1
categories.rules:
# You must kill one Bot in a **Kill Your Friends/Custom Game Match.**

### **General Rules:**

- The game must be in full screen.
- Stretched resolution or FOV changes are not allowed.
- No essential verification elements should be covered.
- The **Kill Your Friends/Custom Game Lobby** must be shown at the start of the video.
- In-game audio is required.
- All runs are timed in milliseconds.
- Macros (wiggle/struggle/AFK, etc.) are not allowed.
- Bugs/glitches are allowed if they provide no advantage.

### **Killer vs Bot:**

- The run starts when the black bars (top/bottom) disappear.
- Recording must start before adding the bot.
- The recording must end at the scoreboard, showing both screens at the end of the match.
- Any perks, items, offerings, and maps are allowed.
- Timing ends when:
    - The red bar under the last bot disappears.
    - If using a mori, when the HUD reappears.
- RTA timing is required; pausing the timer is not allowed.
- If the bot addition is not shown, it must be edited to confirm it is not a real player.
- If both screens are not shown at the end, the bot removal must be shown for the run to remain valid.

categories.name: Escape
categories.rules:
# You must escape **via the hatch or gate**.

### **General Rules:**

- The timer starts when the black bars (top/bottom) disappear.
- The run ends when the **escape icon** appears.
- The run will be **rejected** if:
    - The **Killer is farming or AFK**.
    - Players **do not play as intended** to get the hatch.
    - Players **try to kill themselves** to get the hatch.
- All runs are **timed in milliseconds**.
- **Macros** (wiggle/struggle/AFK, etc.) are **not allowed**.
- Bugs/glitches are allowed **if they provide no advantage**.

### **Solo:**

- **Communication in the lobby is prohibited**.
- Recording must start **from the queueing lobby** to prove it is a solo run.

### **SWF (Survive With Friends):**

- The timer ends when **the person recording escapes**.
- If **two or more players match a record, the new record will replace the old one** (previous runs will be rejected).
- Recording must start **from the queueing lobby** to prove it is an SWF run, even if using voice communication.

### **KYF (Kill Your Friends):**

- **The footage must be from the survivor’s perspective**.

# **Glyph Challenges:**

**Red, Blue, pink, yellow, green and Purple Glyph:**

- Capture the glyph that appears in the game.
- The time ends when the **"commune with glyph"** bar disappears after capturing the glyph.

**White Glyph:**

- Capture the glyph and leave it in the basement.
- The time ends when the **"commune with glyph"** bar disappears after leaving the glyph in the basement.

**Orange Glyph:**

- Capture the glyph and hook survivors **6 times**.
- The time ends when the **hook bar** appears next to the survivor after the 6th hook.

**Pink Challenge:**

- Find the glyph, gain the exposed effect, find the glyph again, and capture it.
- The time ends when the **"commune with glyph"** bar disappears after capturing the glyph.

**General Rules:**

- Start recording in the lobby and end it after collecting the glyph.
- The game must be in **full screen**.
- **Stretched resolution or FOV changes** are rejected.
- Ensure nothing essential is covered for verification.
- **In-game audio** is required.
- **RTA sync** is required; pausing the timer is **not allowed**.
- All runs are timed in **milliseconds**.
- **Macros** (wiggle/struggle/AFK, etc.) are **not allowed**.
- Bugs/glitches that provide **no advantage** will be accepted.

### **All Runs:**

- **Activate the glyph challenge** in the archives.
- The run starts when the **black bars (top/bottom)** disappear.
- Any **Perks, Items, Add-ons, and Offerings** are allowed.

categories.rules:
# Keep the chase as long as possible in public matches.

### **SURVIVOR CATEGORY**

#### **General Rules:**

- **Only in public matches**.
- The game must be in **full screen**.
- Ensure nothing is covered that is needed for verification.
- **Lobby** must be shown at the start of the video.
- **Audio** must be in the game.
- You can use any **Perks, Items, Add-ons, and Offerings**.
- **Macros** (wiggle/struggle/AFK, etc.) are **not allowed**.
- Bugs/glitches that provide **no advantage** are accepted.
- If anyone **does not play the game** as intended, the run may be rejected.

#### **Timing:**

- Timer starts when **chase music** and **chase icon** appear.
- The run ends when you **escape** the chase (chase bloodpoint scoring event appears) or the killer wins the chase (dying state icon appears).
- If the killer downs you and another survivor saves you (via stun/blind), the chase timer **resets** if the killer chases you again.
- If the chase music is interrupted briefly, the **mod’s decision** will determine if it’s accepted or rejected.

example of the category:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RL-qPPtrZuo

There are 3 chases in this run:

- 2:25-2:54 (29 seconds)

- 3:49-5:58 (2 min 9 sec)

- 7:16-8:35 (1 min 19 sec)

Only the longest chase counts for your run, which is in this case 2 mins 9 sec.

categories.rules:
# All survivors must be killed or sacrificed.

### **General Rules:**

- Recording must start in the lobby and optionally end at the scoreboard.
- If in-game names are turned off, the scoreboard must be shown at the end.
- The game must be in full screen.
- Stretched resolution or FOV changes are not allowed.
- No essential verification elements should be covered.
- In-game audio is required.
- Timing:
    - Starts when the black bars (top/bottom) disappear.
    - Ends when the last hook bar next to the player's name disappears.
    - If the last survivor is killed with Memento Mori or a similar ability (Finishing Mori, Killer Power), time ends when the "kill" bloodpoint score event appears (top right).
- RTA timing is required, pausing is not allowed.
- Runs are timed in milliseconds.
- Macros (wiggle/struggle/AFK, etc.) are not allowed.
- Bugs/glitches are allowed if they provide no advantage.

### **Solo:**

- Any Perks, Items, Add-ons and Offerings are allowed.
- The run is invalid if:
    - A player is AFK, throwing, or trying to kill themselves.
    - The killer does not interact with a survivor who then disconnects.
    - two or more disconnect
- The run remains valid if:
    - All four survivors are downed, have not been hooked, and a maximum of four disconnect (applies in similar cases).
    - If a survivor commits suicide on the hook but 3 of the 4 survivors are in the dying state, on a hook or dead
    - If two or more survivors are disconnected but have previously hooked or put in a dying state.

### **KYF (Kill Your Friends):**

- The host chooses the map.
- All survivors must be killed.
- Any Perks, Items, Add-ons, and Offerings are allowed.

games.name: Dead by Daylight
games.rules:
Welcome to our Dead by Daylight Speedrunning Ruleset!

- PTB runs will not be accepted.
- Runs must be from patch **6.1.0 onwards**.
- Runs using **event objects or boosts** that provide an advantage **to you** will be rejected.
- Allowed game modifiers: **Chaos Shuffle**.
- Not allowed game modifiers/mode: **2v8, Lights Out, My Little Oni**

#### **Run Requirements:**

- **Start in the lobby, end at the scoreboard screen**.
- Each run can only be submitted for **one category**.
- Game must be in **full screen**.
- **Minimum 720p 30FPS**, raw footage only (no cuts or speed-ups).
- **No overlays** covering necessary verification elements.
- **In-game audio** must be included.
- Runs must be **recorded and submitted by the player themselves**.
- **Modded controllers, hacked/injected accounts will lead to rejection**.

#### **Timing & Other Rules:**

- **Start and end timing follows category rules**.
- All runs are **timed in milliseconds**.
- **Macros are not allowed** (Wiggle, Struggle, AFK, etc.)
- Bugs/glitches that **don’t give an advantage** will be accepted.
- Disconnects will be judged at the verifier’s discretion.
